description: A shell script containing tests for Git's fetch, push, and fsck behavior under strict mode, including setup, object corruption, and validation scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the preceding command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_copy_bytes
methods.description: Copies a specified number of bytes from input.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Generates or retrieves object IDs for testing.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
